clue.text: One under orders from minister Maude getting fuel container

parts.note: Francis Maude was a Conservative cabinet minister when the puzzle appeared
a can holds petrol or other fuel

explanation.surface: A subordinate takes instructions from a government minister while carrying a jerrycan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One under orders' reads like any subordinate, but here it means someone in a religious order.
explanation.definitionFit: A Franciscan friar belongs to a religious order founded by St Francis, so lives under its rule.

clue.text: Mark diatribe as outrageous

parts.note: to flag something is to mark it out
a rant is an angry diatribe

explanation.surface: Someone labels a furious tirade as beyond the pale.
explanation.definitionFit: Flagrant means glaringly offensive, a shocking breach plain for all to see.

clue.text: Fantastic Bali captivates one not having been there

indicators.note: captivates means holds captive, so the rearranged letters hold the next piece inside
fantastic suggests the word Bali is turned into something unreal, rearranged

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Wonderful Bali charms a person who has never actually visited it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'captivates' puts I inside ALIB, the rearrangement of BALI made by 'Fantastic'.
explanation.definitionFit: An alibi is a claim of being elsewhere when a crime happened, the plea of absence.

clue.text: Elite car, upwardly mobile type of Jaguar, more than once involving dodgy deal

indicators.note: involving means the repeated piece wraps around the next one
more than once means the built piece appears twice over
in a down clue, moving upwards means the car's letters are read from bottom to top

parts.note: Merc is short for a Mercedes car
the E-type is a classic Jaguar sports car

indicators.note: dodgy means unsound, so the word deal is rearranged

explanation.surface: A top-class Jaguar, bought by a social climber, keeps featuring in a shady transaction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upwardly mobile' turns MERC into CREM; adding E and doubling it via 'more than once' gives CREME twice, and 'involving' wraps that around DELA, the rearrangement of DEAL signalled by 'dodgy'.
explanation.definitionFit: French for 'cream of the cream', the phrase means the very best of a group, its select top people.

clue.text: Tabloid lot's star not in the ascendant at this time

definitions.text: star not in the ascendant at this time

parts.note: The Sun is a British tabloid newspaper
a set is a lot or group of things; the 's is a link meaning 'is'

explanation.surface: A celebrity's fortunes are fading, as the tabloid crowd now reports.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is cryptic: the star is the sun itself, which is going down rather than rising at that hour.
explanation.definitionFit: At dusk the sun sinks below the horizon, so a star is descending rather than climbing.

clue.text: Basic way to emulate Johnny Cash, leaving wife indefinitely?

indicators.note: leaving means the following piece departs from the phrase

parts.note: Johnny Cash sang 'I Walk the Line', so to copy him you would walk a line

explanation.surface: A simple way to copy a country singer, once the spouse has walked out for good.
explanation.walkthrough: 'indefinitely' tells you the song's definite 'the' becomes the indefinite 'a'. In chemistry, basic means alkaline, the opposite of acidic, not 'simple'.
explanation.definitionFit: In chemistry a basic substance has a pH above seven, the opposite of acidic.

clue.text: Unwelcome approach from old man into kinky sex

indicators.note: into means the next piece goes inside the letters for kinky sex

parts.note: S and M, sadomasochism, is kinky sex
pa is a familiar word for father, one's old man

explanation.surface: An elderly man makes an unwanted proposition about some bedroom games.
explanation.definitionFit: Spam is junk email, an unsolicited message landing in your inbox.

clue.text: Greek character recently collecting small items that may grow in value

definitions.text: collecting small items that may grow in value

parts.note: phi is a letter of the Greek alphabet
lately means recently

explanation.surface: A Greek person has taken up hoarding little things that might appreciate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Greek character' looks like a person from Greece but is a letter of the Greek alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: Stamp collecting gathers small stamps, some of which become valuable over time.

clue.text: What's the attraction of uploading podcast item?

indicators.note: in a down clue, loading upward means the letters are read from the bottom

parts.note: a gam is a pod, a school of whales
a net is something cast by a fisherman

explanation.surface: Someone wonders what is so appealing about putting a podcast episode online.
explanation.walkthrough: 'podcast' must be split into 'pod' and 'cast'; the whole surface about broadcasting online is misdirection.
explanation.definitionFit: A magnet draws iron towards it, so it is literally the source of pull.

clue.text: It's used to clean search site between areas of vegetation

indicators.note: between means the search site sits in the middle of the two vegetation words

parts.note: scrub is low stunted vegetation
brush is undergrowth or thicket
Bing is Microsoft's web search engine

explanation.surface: A tool for cleaning: an internet search engine sits amid patches of shrubland.
explanation.definitionFit: A stiff-bristled scrubbing brush is a cleaning tool for floors and pots.

clue.text: Animated, Dave and Nick worked together in absolute affection

parts.note: A is an abbreviation for absolute, as in absolute temperature

indicators.note: in means the reworked names go inside the word for affection

parts.note: liking means fondness or affection

indicators.note: worked together means the two names are kneaded into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Two friends named Dave and Nick collaborated, totally fond of one another and full of life.
explanation.walkthrough: 'worked together' turns DAVE and NICK into VEANDKIC, which 'in' places inside LIKING after the LI, all after A.
explanation.definitionFit: Lively and vigorous, still very much active and in good health.

clue.text: Swilling ale with relish, cause trouble

indicators.note: swilling means sloshing around, so the letters of ale and relish are churned up

explanation.surface: Gulping beer with gusto, someone becomes rowdy.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for making a great commotion or fuss, causing a disturbance.

clue.text: Back fantastic horse after outsiders seen off in practice

indicators.note: back means the remaining letters are read in reverse order
outsiders seen off means the first and last letters are removed

parts.note: Pegasus is the winged horse of Greek myth

explanation.surface: Someone backs a fancy horse in training once the long shots have been beaten.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outsiders seen off' strips PEGASUS to EGASU, and 'Back' turns it into the answer. The racing surface (backing outsiders) is misdirection.
explanation.definitionFit: Usage is customary practice, the way something is habitually done.

clue.text: Almost half of sailors getting sea sickness

indicators.note: almost half of means fewer than half the letters of the word are kept, from the front

parts.note: nautical means relating to sailors and seafaring

explanation.surface: Most of the crew are getting seasick.
explanation.walkthrough: NAUTICAL has eight letters; keeping three, just under half, gives NAU.
explanation.definitionFit: Nausea is the queasy feeling of wanting to vomit, a form of illness.

clue.text: Rash, foolish act -I rue failing to finish and getting the wind up

indicators.note: foolish suggests the letters are muddled into a new order
failing to finish means the word loses its final letter
in a down clue, up means the letters are read from the bottom

parts.note: air is a wind or breeze

explanation.surface: Someone regrets a silly act, giving up partway and getting scared.
explanation.walkthrough: 'failing to finish' cuts RUE to RU; 'foolish' rearranges ACT, I and RU to URTICA; 'up' turns AIR into RIA. 'Rash' looks like an adjective but is the skin complaint.
explanation.definitionFit: Urticaria is hives, an itchy skin eruption with raised welts.

clue.text: Authorise former England manager to dispense with wingers

indicators.note: wingers are the outside players, so the first and last letters are dropped

parts.note: Terry Venables managed the England football team in the 1990s

explanation.surface: Approve the ex-England boss getting rid of his wide players.
explanation.walkthrough: Wingers are footballers on the flanks, so the word's first and last letters go.
explanation.definitionFit: To enable is to make possible or empower, giving someone the means to act.

clue.text: Meeting of world ambassadors rejecting American from embed-that's awkward

parts.note: UNGA is the United Nations General Assembly

indicators.note: rejecting means the following letter is thrown out

parts.note: to inlay is to set something into a surface

explanation.surface: A gathering of diplomats turns down a US reporter attached to troops, and things get uncomfortable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'embed' suggests an embedded journalist, but here it is a verb meaning to set into.
explanation.definitionFit: Clumsy and lacking grace in movement.

clue.text: Assistant bearing what's said to help golfers-source of refreshment?

indicators.note: what's said means the letters sound like a word spoken, not as spelt

parts.note: a tee is the peg that helps golfers by holding the ball
in a down clue, bearing means carrying the first part on top

explanation.surface: A golfer's helper carries a peg and ball, and offers a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A tea caddy is a small tin holding tea leaves for brewing a cuppa.

clue.text: Works out temperature falls

parts.note: rain falls, so rains means falls

explanation.surface: A weather report: the thermometer drops.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Works out' looks like 'calculates' but means exercises.
explanation.definitionFit: To train is to exercise regularly, as athletes do at the gym.

clue.text: Catalyst in feeding frenzy, meat's uncovered

indicators.note: uncovered means the letters are revealed lying inside the words frenzy and meat

explanation.surface: Sharks in a feeding frenzy lay the meat bare.
explanation.walkthrough: 'feeding frenzy' looks like one phrase, but 'feeding' belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Digestive enzymes speed up the chemical breakdown of food in the body.

clue.text: Give financial backing to young dog making money?

parts.note: a pro, or professional, is paid for what they do
a pup is a young dog

explanation.surface: Should one invest in a puppy that earns its keep?
explanation.definitionFit: To support something failing with money, keeping it from collapse.

clue.text: DJ, no longer in use, taking speed for a lift

indicators.note: in a down clue, lifting means the letters are read upwards
taking means the first word holds the next piece inside it

parts.note: out means out of fashion, no longer used
dex, short for Dexedrine, is slang for speed, an amphetamine

explanation.surface: A disc jockey who has retired takes amphetamines for a high.
explanation.walkthrough: DJ is a dinner jacket, not a disc jockey. 'taking' puts DEX inside OUT to make ODEXUT, and 'for a lift' turns it upward.
explanation.definitionFit: A tuxedo is the American word for a dinner jacket, formal evening wear.

clue.text: Some of the collected letters of Pierre Curie come back to one's mind

indicators.text: Some of the collected letters of
indicators.note: some of the letters means only a run of the letters of the name is taken

explanation.surface: Extracts from the published correspondence of a famous French scientist keep coming to mind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'collected letters' suggests correspondence, but it means the alphabetic letters in the name.
explanation.definitionFit: To recur is to happen or return again, as a thought that keeps resurfacing.

clue.text: Acquit a criminal holding qualification in synchronised swimming?

indicators.note: holding means the rearranged letters wrap around the next piece
criminal suggests the letters are crooked, rearranged

parts.note: a BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a degree qualification

explanation.surface: A court clears a lawbreaker who holds a degree in water sports.
explanation.walkthrough: 'criminal' rearranges ACQUIT A into AQUATIC, which 'holding' wraps around BA.
explanation.definitionFit: Aquabatic describes acrobatic display in water, such as a choreographed pool routine.

clue.text: Spike on end of hart's antler

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means the first piece sits above the second
end of means only the final letter of the word is taken

parts.note: a horn is an antler

explanation.surface: A prong at the tip of a stag's antler.
explanation.walkthrough: A hart is a male deer.
explanation.definitionFit: A thorn is a sharp spine on a plant, a prickle.

clue.text: E.g. biopic of Natalie scrapped due to war

parts.note: Natalie Portman is a Hollywood actress

indicators.note: scrapped means broken up, so the letters of due to war are rearranged

explanation.surface: A film about an actress's life was cancelled because of conflict.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scrapped' rearranges DUE TO WAR into TEAUWORD. 'biopic' is blended from 'biographical' and 'picture'.
explanation.definitionFit: A blend merging two words into one, as biopic fuses biographical and picture.

clue.text: High voice (not soprano)

indicators.note: not means the following letter is left out

parts.note: to speak is to voice something
S is the abbreviation for soprano in music

explanation.surface: A singer's high register, sung by anyone but a soprano.
explanation.walkthrough: 'voice' looks like a singing part but is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A peak is a high point, the summit or maximum.

clue.text: Excessive submissiveness articulating more deviant desire

indicators.note: articulating means saying the words out loud, so the spoken form counts

parts.note: sicker means more deviant and a fancy is a desire

explanation.surface: Voicing a more twisted craving.
explanation.definitionFit: Sycophancy is fawning flattery, grovelling to win favour.
